title: Mouse Sucks shares new single “My Love”
htmlContent:
Canada Based artist Mouse Sucks is a multi-talented singer and songwriter who is currently diversifying the music with his new sound, “MY LOVE.” He is breaking into the music industry, and his work ethic and ability to strive as an artist despite all odds have made him stand out from all other artists.

Mouse Sucks creates an engaging thriller with a masterful vibe on the new song “MY LOVE.” The dark smooth approach to the sound lets you slow down to take it all in, allowing you to feel the music. Being able to go on the exciting ride of the verses and the central sound in the chorus makes it undeniable for the superior sound. You get an impressive melodic performance full of charisma that sounds just right for this record that the world will hear.
